description: This file contains a Perl script implementing optimized SHA-1 hash computation routines for ARMv4 architecture, including platform-specific optimizations, NEON acceleration, and ARMv8 support. It defines assembly code generation for different ARM architectures and includes platform detection and code translation logic.

methods.name: unsha1
methods.description: Generates assembly instruction strings for ARM SHA-1 instructions based on mnemonic and arguments, including encoding fixes for Thumb mode.
